agentGuide: For an image, use the tool generate_image: it files the picture and shows it in the conversation. If you do not have it, tell the user to give you image generation on your page, then, only if they want the image right away: POST /run/@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell with {"prompt": "…", "steps": 8} and save_as "name.jpg" (Allkin extracts the image from the JSON), then show it with ![description](name.jpg). You do not see the image: do not describe it. GET /models/search?task=Text-to-Image lists the image models.
